mean-reversion-scan 1.0.0

- Initial release of the mean-reversion-scan skill.
- Scans for mean-reversion trading opportunities in RANGING and CHOPPY market conditions.
- Real-time signals sourced from live APEX Runner autonomous trading on Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, and Hyperliquid.
- Requires only an EVM wallet (no account, API key, or subscription).
- Pay-per-call pricing with automatic discount tiers for early adopters and frequent users.
